|   |-- io: termio.Termio -> terminal state, stream parser, backend and IO mailbox
|   |-- renderer: Renderer + renderer_thread -> frame preparation and presentation

|   `-- Exec.threadEnter -> Subprocess.start + PTY reader + process watcher
|       `-- Reader lifetime belongs to the IO backend (src/termio/Exec.zig:86)

|-- [C] Input -> bindings or terminal bytes -> child process

|   |   |-- performBindingAction -> local operations or apprt actions
|   |   `-- [D] KeyEvent + key_encode.Options.fromTerminal + config -> encoded write request
|   |       `-- Terminal modes determine keyboard protocol (src/Surface.zig:3326)
|   |-- mouseButtonCallback / cursorPosCallback / scrollCallback
|   |   `-- Local selection/scrolling or input.mouse_encode reporting, depending on terminal modes
|   |-- completeClipboardRequest -> input.paste.encode -> write requests
|   |   `-- Paste encoding depends on terminal settings, including bracketed paste

|       |-- renderer_mailbox / renderer_wakeup -> render changes and repaint requests
|       `-- surface_mailbox -> App -> Surface.handleMessage -> native UI actions
|           `-- Titles, clipboard requests and other surface effects cross this boundary

|-- [O] Termio.terminal is the renderer-independent session model
|   |-- Terminal (src/terminal/Terminal.zig:1)

|           |-- kitty_keyboard / kitty_images / semantic_prompt -> extended protocol state
|           `-- pages: PageList -> ordered scrollback and active-screen storage

   477	pub fn init(
   478	    self: *Surface,
   479	    alloc: Allocator,
   480	    config_original: *const configpkg.Config,
   481	    app: *App,
   482	    rt_app: *apprt.runtime.App,
   483	    rt_surface: *apprt.runtime.Surface,
   484	) !void {
   485	    // Apply our conditional state. If we fail to apply the conditional state
   486	    // then we log and attempt to move forward with the old config.
   487	    var config_: ?configpkg.Config = config_original.changeConditionalState(
   488	        app.config_conditional_state,
   489	    ) catch |err| err: {
   490	        log.warn("failed to apply conditional state to config err={}", .{err});
   491	        break :err null;
   492	    };
   493	    defer if (config_) |*c| c.deinit();
   494	
   495	    // We want a config pointer for everything so we get that either
   496	    // based on our conditional state or the original config.
   497	    const config: *const configpkg.Config = if (config_) |*c| config: {
   498	        // We want to preserve our original working directory. We
   499	        // don't need to dupe memory here because termio will derive
   500	        // it. We preserve this so directory inheritance works.
   501	        c.@"working-directory" = config_original.@"working-directory";
   502	        break :config c;
   503	    } else config_original;
   504	
   505	    // Get our configuration
   506	    var derived_config = try DerivedConfig.init(alloc, config);
   507	    errdefer derived_config.deinit();
   508	
   509	    // Determine our DPI configurations so we can properly configure
   510	    // font points to pixels and handle other high-DPI scaling factors.
